tools.name: profile
tools.description: Work on profiles of your session: list them (action list, path session:<id> for another session), show what a profile holds with its context tokens (action info), compact its transcript (action compact) or reset it (action reset). compact and reset are for a profile other than your own; a sub-agent may not use them. reset is refused while a run of the profile is active; compact waits for a live run to end.

path.description: What to act on. Omit it, or give self, for your own profile. profile:<category>/<name> (or profile:<session>/<category>/<name>) names another profile; session:<id> names a session, whose profiles action list shows. remote:<name>/profile:<session>/<category>/<name> asks a remote JAD server for info; only when allow_remote is on.

action.description: list: the profiles of the session. info: what the profile holds, with its context tokens. compact: compact the profile's transcript now. reset: delete the profile's transcript and history. compact and reset are refused to a sub-agent and to your own profile. reset is refused while a run of the profile is active; compact waits for a live run to end.

filters.description: Only profiles whose name matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (dev*, *coder); any other is a substring. Only with action list.

limit.description: Most items in this response; capped by the configuration. Only with action list.

cursor.description: Continue where the previous list response stopped; use the cursor it gave. Only with action list.
